notes_for_editor: Thin record. Three lists give the agency, county, tower name and a gone status; no source read gives a build date, staffing, fire record or site condition. Two web searches and a Portal to Texas History search for 'Buna lookout' (no hits) found nothing more. County: the lists put the tower in Newton County, while TSHA and the Wikipedia infobox put the town of Buna in Jasper County. The record county was left as Newton because every list agrees; the boundary was not checked. The Forest Fire Lookout Association list is the only source for the gone status.
